steps.question: Does the agent's closing message ask the user for something it is waiting on, such as a choice between ways forward, a preference, information or access it lacks, or permission to go on? Answer no when the message only reports what it did, when the question is one it answers itself, or when its question is part of the answer to a question the user asked.

then.text: Chauffeur: Put that question to the user with the question tool instead of in plain text. Give each way forward as an option, the one you recommend first and marked "(Recommended)", so the answer comes straight back into this same turn. Ask only for what you cannot decide yourself, then carry on from the answer.
